cases.name: 1. Module exports
cases.details: createCoreGateway and createCoreServiceIngress exported from packages/services/core-gateway.js and index.js.

cases.name: 2. Signed command execution
cases.details: API gateway signs forwardCommand with HMAC-SHA256 headers; Core ingress verifies signature and executes convert command (coins debited, crowns credited, durable ledger appended).

cases.name: 3. Forgery and tampering rejection
cases.details: Tampered payload, forged actor ID header, wrong secret, corrupted signature, and missing signature rejected with 403 INVALID_SERVICE_SIGNATURE with zero database mutation.

cases.name: 4. Timestamp drift rejection
cases.details: Stale (>30s) and future (>30s) timestamps rejected with 401 REQUEST_EXPIRED with zero database mutation.

cases.name: 5. OpKey idempotency
cases.details: Replayed forwardCommand with same opKey returns cached outcome without duplicate debit; conflicting payload on same opKey rejects with IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (409).

cases.name: 6. Ticket ingress
cases.details: Signed requestTicket to /ingress/ticket verified and fulfilled.

cases.name: 7. Competitive API routes
cases.details: createApiHandler routes POST /api/v1/convert to Core via coreGateway, enforces auth, forwards idempotency key, and caches duplicate requests.

cases.name: 8. Strict database least privilege
cases.details: api_runtime pool direct UPDATE, INSERT, and DELETE on economy.wallets and economy.ledger throw PostgreSQL 42501 permission denied.

verification.summary: Core service gateway and authenticated ingress implemented in packages/services/core-gateway.js and apps/api/routes/competitive.js. Request signing, forge protection, drift check, opKey idempotency, and strict database least privilege (API role cannot mutate economic tables) proven across 8 dedicated tests on real PG16.
